<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the sample's molecule. The best way is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum, which will show distinct signals for each unique carbon environment. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (~10–30 ppm). By counting the number of such signals, we can infer the number of methyl groups. We'll request the carbon NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
